listingTitle: Keep dynamic data out of child-process shells
title: Keep dynamic data out of child-process shells
why: Dynamic command text passed to exec or to spawn with shell enabled can let untrusted values become shell syntax.
suggestion: Use execFile or spawn without shell mode and pass validated values as separate argument-array entries.
limitations: Named ES module imports, namespace imports, and CommonJS require bindings from child_process are recognized.
Literal const bindings interpolated directly into command templates are recognized; lexical shadowing and values forwarded through wrapper functions are not resolved.
